segments.title: Opening & Audio Experiments
segments.notes: Case Blackwell opens broadcast with new voice modulation tools, tests audio effects, acknowledges subscribers, and banters about Fia's editing.

segments.title: Billionaire Biohacker NFTs with Liliana
segments.notes: Liliana joins desk to discuss Brian Johnson's Solana NFT airdrop with Degen Poet for his 'Don't Die' community; debate over immortality vs. innovation ensues.

segments.title: Hype Train Interruption
segments.notes: Hype Train commandeers feed with freestyle raps over new effects pedal; completes eight minutes prior but remains active on fumes.

segments.title: Cream Team SEO Debate with Kendall
segments.notes: Kendall argues 'cream team' hurts SEO; suggests rebrand to 'creme' or 'show bobas'; auto-tune singing experiments derail discussion.

segments.title: Munch & Crum: Cream Team Name Debate
segments.notes: Munch defends keeping name as identity; Crum argues for algorithmic compliance; poll proposed; Munch declares victory.

segments.title: Unvernished Truth: Doctor Who Watcher Conspiracy
segments.notes: Clementine presents DWFan91 video on the Watcher as psychic manifestation of Doctor's next incarnation; Case dismisses as 'pasty guy from Essex'.

segments.title: Trailer Thursdays with Trent
segments.notes: Trent reviews three trailers: Accidental Texan, Road House remake (Conor McGregor), The Ministry of Ungentlemanly Warfare; debates American values and Irish stereotypes.

segments.title: Moon Shrinking Report with Peter Gibbon
segments.notes: Peter Gibbon emerges from walls to deliver study on moon shrinking 150 feet, moonquakes lasting hours, risks to Artemis missions; penis jokes throughout.

segments.title: Trip on the Street: Park Interviews
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein interviews park visitors: Rob Elvie (banned), Ann O'Nem (defends Craig), Francis Sickner (wall laughter haunting), Skip Keep (prank philosophy).

segments.title: Closing & Raid
segments.notes: Case tests pitch correction, debates raid message, raids Ricky Peacock with 'Ricky P case' spam.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell opens with new voice modulation tools before Liliana joins to dissect billionaire biohacker Brian Johnson's Solana NFT airdrop. Kendall derails the broadcast arguing 'cream team' hurts SEO, leading to a Munch & Crum debate where Munch defends the name as identity. Clementine presents a Doctor Who Watcher conspiracy theory; Trent reviews three trailers including the Conor McGregor Road House remake. Peter Gibbon emerges from the walls to report the moon has shrunk 150 feet causing hour-long moonquakes. Trip Bradstein interviews park visitors including a banned shapeshifter and a man haunted by wall laughter. Broadcast closes with Case testing pitch correction and raiding Ricky Peacock.
